headline: Heard trespass appeal from Eric Gravel before moving into Deliberative Session
summary: The committee held a hearing on the trespass order appeal filed by Eric Gravel, hearing from Gravel and from Daniel Pecor and Michael Van Gulden of Chocolate Thunder, represented by City Attorney Jessica Brown. After questioning both parties, the committee adjourned the public portion of the meeting and moved into Deliberative Session. No decision on the appeal is recorded in these minutes.
plain_text:
Page 1 of 2 
 
 
Public Safety Committee 
Monday, July 27, 2026 
Remote via Zoom/In-Person in Sharon Bushor Conference Room, 1st Floor, City Hall, 
Burlington, Vermont   
DRAFT MINUTES 
  
Members Present:  Buddy Singh (Chair), Melo Grant, Evan Litwin, Laura Sanchez-Parkinson 
  
Staff Present: Hayley McClenahan (Assistant City Attorney), Jessica Brown (City Attorney) 
 
Public Present: Eric Gravel, Daniel Pecor, Todd DeLuca, Michael Van Gulden 
 
Meeting called to order at 6:06 PM by Councilor Singh. 
  
1.   Adopt the Agenda 
     1.01 Adopt the Agenda 
  
Motion to Adopt Agenda as written.   
 
Motion by Councilor Grant, Seconded by Councilor Sanchez-Parkinson 
Final Resolution: Motion Passes 
Yes: Unanimous 
 
2.    Public Forum 
      2.01 Verbal Comments 
 
Todd DeLuca commented on the appellant’s right to record in public spaces and hopes the 
Committee will overturn precedent set from the appellant’s previous trespass appeal hearing.   
 
A member of the public recounted the incident leading to issuance of a trespass from City Hall 
two years ago, stating they felt the grounds for trespass were unfair.   
 
Public Forum closed at 6:11 PM.  
 
3.   Appeal of Trespass Order/Hearing 
     3.01  In re: Matter of Eric Gravel 
 
The Committee heard from Eric Gravel as well as Daniel Pecor and Michael Van Gulden of 
Chocolate Thunder, represented by City Attorney Jessica Brown. The Committee had the 
opportunity to ask questions of both parties before moving to Deliberative Session. 
 
7.  Adjournment 
     7.01 Motion to Adjourn 
 
Motion to adjourn the public portion of the meeting and move into Deliberative Session.
Page 2 of 2 
 
 
Motion by Councilor Grant, Seconded by Councilor Litwin 
Final Resolution: Motion Passes 
Yes: Unanimous 
 
The meeting was adjourned at 7:06 PM.
